query: INSERT INTO replay_progress(device_id,boot_id,through_device_seq,complete,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(device_id,boot_id) DO UPDATE SET through_device_seq=CASE WHEN excluded.through_device_seq IS NULL THEN through_device_seq WHEN through_device_seq IS NULL THEN excluded.through_device_seq ELSE max(through_device_seq,excluded.through_device_seq) END,complete=max(complete,excluded.complete),updated_at=excluded.updated_at
